race.description: The Netty G Runs The Show Mdn
race.comment: THE STALAGMITE (9) has been unplaced in three starts, but his Bunbury Mdn fifth over 1400m was a step in the right direction and he brings strong time-rating support with a 3kg claim. This race looks ideal on what he's done recently and if Li can negotiate the tricky barrier, he'll be hard to hold out. PERFECT SCORE (7) has placed at both starts, was pipped late at this track first-up. She jumped at the pointy end of the market there and it looks to be a soplid platform for her to build on. Can get the job done. IL BELLO BEALS (1) is third-up here and looks well placed on his two runs back this time. JEWEL OF ZAVALA (13) gains a start as an emergency and can't be left out of calculations.
